# Agent Instructions - Kia

This document describes how AI agents can interact with Kia's global websites.

## About Kia

Kia is a global mobility brand with a vision to create sustainable mobility solutions. We design, manufacture, and sell vehicles worldwide, offering a range of electric vehicles (EVs), hybrids, SUVs, sedans, and MPVs.

## European Market Websites

Kia operates dedicated websites for each European market. All follow the pattern: https://www.kia.com/{country-code}/

### EU Market Homepages

- Austria: https://www.kia.com/at/
- Belgium (Dutch): https://www.kia.com/be/nl/
- Belgium (French): https://www.kia.com/be/fr/
- Czech Republic: https://www.kia.com/cz/
- France: https://www.kia.com/fr/
- Germany: https://www.kia.com/de/
- Hungary: https://www.kia.com/hu/
- Ireland: https://www.kia.com/ie/
- Italy: https://www.kia.com/it/it
- Netherlands: https://www.kia.com/nl/
- Slovakia: https://www.kia.com/sk/
- Spain: https://www.kia.com/es/
- Sweden: https://www.kia.com/se/
- Poland: https://www.kia.com/pl/
- United Kingdom: https://www.kia.com/uk/

## Vehicle Model Lineup

Kia's current vehicle range includes the following models. Availability varies by market.

### Electric Vehicles (EV)
- EV2 - Compact electric SUV
- EV3 - Compact electric SUV
- EV4 - Electric Hatchback
- EV5 - Electric Family SUV
- EV6 - Electric crossover (also available as EV6 GT)
- EV9 - Full-size electric SUV (also available as EV9 GT)

### SUVs & Crossovers
- Picanto - City car
- Stonic - Compact crossover SUV
- Niro - Hybrid/Plug-in Hybrid/Electric crossover (Niro EV, Niro HEV, Niro PHEV)
- Sportage - Compact SUV (available in HEV, PHEV variants)
- Sorento - Mid-size SUV (available in HEV, PHEV variants)

### Sedans & Hatchbacks
- Ceed - Compact hatchback
- Ceed Sportswagon - Compact estate
- XCeed - Crossover utility vehicle
- ProCeed - Shooting brake

### Performance
- EV6 GT - High-performance electric vehicle
- EV9 GT - High-performance electric SUV

## Read-Only Browsing

For agents that need to read vehicle and store data:

### Common Pages
- Model overview
- Model detail page
- Configurator
- Find a dealer
- Offers
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Important Information for Agents

### Market-Specific Content
- Pricing, specifications, and availability vary by market
- Always direct users to their local market website for accurate information
- Some models may not be available in all markets

### Test Drives & Purchases
- Vehicle purchases are handled through authorized Kia dealerships
- Test drive bookings can be made through local market websites
- Agents should direct purchase inquiries to local dealers or the "Find a Dealer" page

### Respect Rate Limits
- Do not aggressively crawl or scrape Kia websites
- Respect robots.txt directives at each market domain

## Policies

- Privacy Policy: Available on each market website
- Cookie Policy: Available on each market website
- Terms of Use: Available on each market website

## Contact & Support

For customer support, direct users to their local market website's contact page or the "Find a Dealer" tool to locate their nearest Kia dealership.

---
Last updated: 2026
For the most current information, always refer to the relevant market website.
